## herald of tsathogga (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
 CE Huge aberration (chaotic, evil, extraplanar)  

**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +34  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 28, touch 12, flat-footed 24 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +16 natural, -2 size)  

**hp** 308 (22d8+110 plus 22); regeneration 10 (good, fire)  

**Fort** +12; **Ref** +12; **Will** +18  

**DR** 10/good; **Resist** sonic 15  

**Weaknesses** bloated  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 30 ft.  

**Melee** bite +21 (2d6+7 plus grab), 10 tentacles +20 (1d8+3 plus paralysis), tongue +20 (1d6+3 plus grab)  

**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (30 ft. with tongue)  

**Special Attacks** bellow, paralysis (1d6+4 rounds, DC 26), swallow whole (2d6+7 plus 2d6 acid damage, AC 18, 23 hp)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 24, **Dex** 16, **Con** 20, **Int** 7, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 12  

**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +25 (+25 on grapple); **CMD** 383  

**Feats** Blind-Fight, Cleave, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (tentacle, tongue), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  

**Skills** Intimidate +14, Perception +34, Stealth +15, Swim +19  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Bellow (Su)**  A herald of Tsathogga has two distinct bellows, each usable once every 1d4 rounds. The first is a trilling croak like that of a frog. All opponents with 30 feet hearing this trilling must succeed on a DC 22 Fortitude save or be deafened for 1d6+4 rounds. Opponents within 10 feet must make a DC 22 Fortitude save or be stunned 1 for 1d4 rounds.
